0022600092.text: The Phoenix Suns visit the Portland Trail Blazers in a game that opens the 2026-27 season for both teams, and Phoenix is without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), all out, and Deni Avdija (ankle) and Micah Potter (illness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. In 2025-26 the Suns won the season series 2-1, but their most recent meeting, on 2026-02-22 in Phoenix, ended in a 92-77 loss, and there are no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
